The venv copy's DEFAULT_YOSYS_TIMEOUT_S was relaxed 300 -> 3600 (timeout only; same deck) to survive current host load, the same relaxation prior records made in a uvx cache copy.

command: scripts/synth-soc.sh (x2: unmodified main @ 566365d in a detached scratch worktree, then the merged PR tree at this commit); verification/tools/lint_rtl.sh (default and LINT_REQUIRE_CORE=1 forms); make -C verification soc-gate; the three signoff.yml legs via klt signoff --check
note: Resynthesis for PR #168 (issue #153): the UART TX shift register narrowed from 10 to 9 bits (bit 0 was written three times and read zero times; the start bit is driven directly at frame start). The branch also merged current origin/main, whose b3be3df had removed soc_fabric's dead per_gnt tie cell (#182), so the merged tree's attested sources moved again and this record re-establishes the chain on the combined tree. synth_result.json is this commit's klt output; synth_result_baseline.json is the unmodified-main run's, kept so the before figures are auditable rather than asserted. The baseline netlist reproduced main's committed one byte-for-byte (sha256 160672fe...), so the after-delta is the RTL changes, not the toolchain. The regenerated netlist is byte-identical to the merge's own auto-merged netlist -- the two sides' changed regions did not overlap, and running the synthesis confirms the textual merge was the true netlist of the combined sources. Both runs used TMPDIR unset -- klt synthesize deadlocks in Yosys' abc pass on this host under the loom sandbox TMPDIR (same note as the records this one follows; filed at 2AMLogic/klayout-tools); every committed netlist was produced that way.

after.combinational_only: the uart shift-register narrowing removes one flop from the RTL, but bit 0 was already merged into the txd_o output drive, so abc's re-mapping shows up as +16 combinational cells and -12.512 um2; every sequential cell type (dfrtp_1 2132, dfstp_2 97, dlxtn_1 1, edfxtp_1 38), conb_1 count and all 8 SRAM macro instances are identical to the baseline run

supersedes.note: The superseded record itself superseded 20261115T205309Z-5e9335c (netlist e4592eca...), which the PR review originally asked this record to name; main moved again while the PR waited, so the chain names the actual newest. records/soc-sta-preroute/ and records/soc-pnr/ bind that netlist and so describe a netlist one change old. The delta is combinational-only (sequential_area_um2 identical at 70829.1808, every flop count identical), so no recorded timing claim moves in the unsafe direction -- but re-running pre-route STA and P&R on the current netlist is outstanding work, not covered here.
